game_concept: A speed quiz set in The Kingdom – Village Green, the green outside the walls: the squire must handle rogue knights while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Uninitialized Hunt: Find variables used before assignment and fix them before rogue knights exploit the gap.
theme: The Kingdom – Village Green: the green outside the walls
core_gameplay_loop: Read the requested procedure, drag flowchart shapes into the chart, then run checks against example inputs and expected outputs.
player_objective: Collect 340 points of torches by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Drag blocks from the tray into chart positions. Drag them back to remove them. Check chart runs the algorithm. Keyboard: [ or ] selects a block, arrows choose a position, Enter places, C checks, Escape pauses.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 340, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: CP1 Week 1: Controls and mission practice
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Uninitialized Hunt' (Week 1 slot 15), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Village Green'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how bugs_fixed changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue knights in Village Green.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 340 within 34 seconds.
